# EntSQL: A Benchmark for Grounding Text-to-SQL in Long-Context Enterprise Knowledge

[All reading notes](../reading-notes.md) · [Catalog entry](../README.md#entsql)

**Full paper read · 2026-11-09**

[Original source](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2606.03363v3) · arXiv:2606.03363v3, 14 July 2026

**Reading coverage:** All ten PDF pages, Sections 1-5, limitations/ethics, Tables 1-4 and Figures 1-4; Figure 2 rendered visually to recover damaged font extraction. No appendices in the PDF.

**Additional inspected sources:** [Official dataset card and file listing](https://huggingface.co/datasets/XuWave/Rethinking_Enterprise_Text_to_SQL)

## Research question

Enterprise SQL depends on metric definitions, fiscal conventions and organizational rules that cannot be inferred from schemas alone.

## Method

EntSQL assembles anonymized enterprise questions, SQL, concise expert evidence, synthesized long documents and SQLite databases. Chinese-English pairs share semantic targets; difficulty is a coarse SQL-token-length grouping.

## Evaluation

The full English set has 1,066 examples across five domains from one enterprise. Seven standalone LLMs and Claude Code are evaluated with schema-only, long-document and concise-evidence inputs. The agent uses its default framework without a matched turn budget. Additional expert and bilingual subset analyses are reported.

## What the results support

Best full-document execution accuracy is 15.9%, versus 6.8% schema-only and 21.4% with concise evidence. Expert gains and domain breakdowns indicate both knowledge selection and SQL composition difficulties.

## Limits and qualifications

Results are not matched-budget comparisons of agent and single-call systems. Bilingual analysis covers two domains, error analysis one model, and execution agreement is instance-bound. Multi-turn clarification, access control and broader enterprise transfer are future work.

## Relevance to reliable Text-to-SQL

Provides missing-context evaluation distinct from the BAR-SQL Ent-SQL-Bench. The previously unverified artifact is now located: public database archives and bilingual JSON exist, but gold answers are withheld.
